searchText: After the merge, will devp2p still be used as the networking protocol for the execution layer? Yes There is some desire to deprecate over time but execution layer sync and tx gossip will remain stable, at least at first Block gossip on the execution layer is deprecated by the merge and will be handled by the consensus layer, other than that no changes to devp2p are expected have we had any interop effort or any instructions on how to set up consensus/execution clients to interop? I guess client teams will publish docker images and instructions on how to run their clients. There is also a set of provision tools and respective guide that we used to run devnets during the Rayonism (https://github.com/protolambda/mergenet-tutorial), it should be updated as well
